title.en: Common Services Tunnels (Marina Bay Common Services Tunnel Area Protection Zone) Regulations 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Common Services Tunnels (Marina Bay Common Services Tunnel Area Protection Zone) Regulations 2021.

3. A person seeking to carry out engineering works in the Marina Bay CST Area may —
(a)inspect (without charge) any CST boundary plans or maps for the area of the engineering works at the office of the CST Authority (during the hours when that office is normally open to the public); and
(b)be provided (without charge) with a copy of such boundary plans or maps as an authorised officer considers relevant to the engineering works.

heading.en: Technical plans or maps in relation to protection zone

text.en:
4.—(1) Subject to paragraph (2), a person who carries out engineering works in the Marina Bay CST Area may, at the person’s request and upon payment of a fee of $82.50, be provided with a copy of any technical plans or maps relating to the common services tunnel or any ancillary facility of the common services tunnel —
(a)that may be affected by the engineering works; or
(b)the safe and efficient operation and functionality of which may be affected by the engineering works.
[S 762/2025 wef 01/12/2025]
(2) The provision of any technical plans or maps under paragraph (1) is subject to the condition that the person —
(a)agrees to keep the technical plans or maps confidential; and
(b)executes a written undertaking (in the form determined by the CST Authority) to keep the technical plans or maps confidential.
